```{r}
#| label: setup

source("_setup.R")
```

## Data Import

ASP scale profiles across latent classes are read in from the project's Excel results workbook. Import code is included but not rendered below.

```{r}
#| label: import
#| echo: false
asp_raw <- read_excel(data_path, sheet = "asp profiles R")
```

## Build Dataframes

Standardized profile dataframe (z-scored predictors + % male).

```{r}
#| label: build-profile
pred_order <- c("support", "involve", "warmth", "Zsupport", "Zinvolve", "Zwarmth")

display_labels <- c(
    "support" = "Autonomy Support",
  "involve"    = "Parental Involvement",
    "warmth"     = "Parental Warmth",
    "support" = "Autonomy Support",
  "involve"    = "Parental Involvement",
    "warmth"     = "Parental Warmth"
)

asp_df <- asp_raw %>%
  filter(Covariate %in% pred_order) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Cluster1, Cluster2, Cluster3, Cluster4),
    names_to = "cluster", values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cluster   = factor(recode(cluster,
                   Cluster1 = "C1", Cluster2 = "C2",
                   Cluster3 = "C3", Cluster4 = "C4"),
                 levels = c("C1","C2","C3","C4")),
    Covariate = factor(Covariate, levels = pred_order),
    display   = factor(display_labels[as.character(Covariate)],
                       levels = display_labels[pred_order])
  )
```


## Profile Figures (Standardized)

```{r}
#| label: fig-asp-Zsupport

p_aspZ <- ggplot(asp_df %>% filter(Covariate == "Zsupport"),
                aes(x = cluster, y = value, fill = cluster)) +
  geom_col(width = bar_width) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = ref_line_color,
             linewidth = ref_line_lwd, linetype = ref_line_type) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_colors, name = "Cluster") +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Mean",
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.08, 0.08)),
                     labels = number_format(accuracy = 0.01)) +
  labs(title = "Autonomy Support",
       caption = "Mean standardized (z-scored) autonomy-supportive parenting score by latent class.") +
  or_theme +  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank())
print(p_aspZ)
ggsave(file.path(fig_asp_profiles, "stand_asp.png"),
       plot = p_aspZ, width = 5, height = 4, dpi = fig_dpi, units = "in")
```
